draft.summary: The Commission opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging. The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.
draft.source_quote:
Commission opens consultation on bio-based plastic packaging
The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.
